basic_info.description: $205,000 price improvement. Amazing value! Welcome home to 1017 Greenwich Street and be prepared to be wowed. This one-of-a-kind 2-level VIEW property has it all. Situated on a prime corner of Russian Hill, just steps to vibrant North Beach, FiDi and Hyde & Polk St restaurants and boutiques, this luxe 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom home boasts 3 private outdoor spaces including a sprawling 500 sq ft deeded view deck (with built-in BBQ and custom seating, heatlamps & lighting). Enjoy breathtaking VIEWS of Coit Tower, Alcatraz, Bay & City while relaxing and entertaining. The expansive top-floor pent-room offers equally magnificent views from picture windows on 2 sides and features a full wet-bar, fireplace and full bathroom.    The main level flows easily from the state-of-the-art open kitchen with professional grade appliances (including built-in espresso machine) and adjacent deck to the large dining area. The hallway leads to 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including a luxurious primary suite with 2 view balconies, bespoke window treatments, spa-like bathroom and walk-in closet.   Gorgeous hardwood floors with radiant heating throughout, in-unit laundry, custom remote-controlled window treatments, built-in speakers, intercom, 2 car parking, low HOA dues and much more..
